Part II - Airline On-Time Performance Data¶

by Jiri Valenta¶

Investigation Overview¶

This presentation is to conclude the analysis of "Airline On-Time Performance Data" reports dataset and to publish key findings. My analysis focused mainly on cancellations, departure and arrival delays and their predictions based on other available parameters, like timeframes, airports and carriers.

Dataset Overview¶

The dataset "Airline On-Time Performance Data" reports flights in the United States, including carriers, arrival and departure delays, and reasons for the delays, from 1987 to 2008. The data is collected by the Office of Airline Information, Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS).

Frequency of cancellations for selected periods¶

Are there any months with the higher probability of your flight being cancelled?

December, January and February seems to be the months with the higher frequency of cancellations. These are the winter months in the northern hemisphere so the disruptions can be attributed to the variable weather conditions ....but why there is another peak for September?

Since our data covers a relatively small sample for the years between 1987 and 2008, even a single 'unusual' year can have a high impact on the avarage monthly statistics. As revealed it was year 2001 with it's tragic events of 9/11.

Busy hours for airports¶

What are the most busy hours for departures and arrivals?

In terms of departures the most airlines' operations start between 6am and 7am. As expected the arrivals are starting to pick up an hour later, around 8am. Also, the arrivals histogram is more left-skewed than the departures one. Most probably due to regulations, the airlines try to minimize departures during the night hours.

Reasons for the delays¶

What are the main reasons for the delays and is there any trend throughout the years?

The longest average delays are caused by the wait for the connecting flights, followed by NAS delays and delays incurred due to carrier operations. The least delays are caused by the security reasons.

The length of the weather delays is slightly declining while the delays due to the late aircraft are getting longer.

NAS delay definition: Weather delays that could be reduced with corrective action by the airports or the Federal Aviation Administration.

Early departures and arrivals¶

How are early departures and arrivals related?

Does the longer airtime help significantly to make up for the departure delay and arrive on-time?

Departure and arrival delays are as expected strongly positively correlated. There is surprisingly a density of early departures and arrivals in the dataset. Those that departed late but still arrived early are more among the flights with a longer airtime.

The best performing airline¶

Which airline is the best performing in terms of least delays?

The best performing airline in terms of both departure and arrival times is Hawaiian (HA).

An article from HA's website (Feb 25, 2021): https://newsroom.hawaiianairlines.com/releases/hawaiian-airlines-maintains-on-time-performance-record-for-17th-consecutive-year
